title: Vietnamese-Style Zesty Chicken
description: A flavorful and spicy Vietnamese-inspired dish featuring zesty chicken, flaky crust, and a hint of bo kho spices.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together flour, zesty spice blend, and bo kho spice.
In a separate dish, beat eggs.
Dip each chicken breast into the eggs, coating completely, then coat in the flour mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Dip the coated chicken breast into the crushed pork rinds, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the coated chicken breasts on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with fish sauce and lime juice, if using.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the crust is golden brown.
While the chicken is baking, mix together sugar and zesty spice blend in a small bowl.
Remove the chicken from the oven and brush with the sugar-zesty spice mixture.
Return the chicken to the oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes or until the crust is caramelized.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
